name: Mohawk
source:
A member of the mercenary group Fenrir. Native American by blood and a Designer's Child, his taciturn nature and imposing physique render him frightening at first glance, but in truth he has a gentle personality and cares deeply about his comrades.

He pilots the Simulacrum "Megingjord".
